method: OpenCV 5 BarcodeDetector on original, EXIF-corrected owner reference photos at original resolution and 1.5x upscaled resolution; visual package-label cross-check

limitations: A barcode not decoded from a photo may be absent, out of frame, blurred, distorted, or unreadable; this does not prove the product has no GTIN.
